rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: A meeting of the office bearers and senior leaders took place on 18 October 2004 'with Party President Shri M. Venkaiah Naidu in the chair'.

locator.section: first sentence of the statement dated October 18, 2004

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: At that meeting 'Shri Venkaiah Naidu offered to resign from his post for personal reasons', saying a senior leader should assume the office of the Party President; colleagues declined to accept the resignation and tried to persuade him to continue, but he 'stood firm on his decision to step down'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: 'With much reluctance, the resignation was accepted' at the same meeting.

locator.section: sentence 'With much reluctance, the resignation was accepted.'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The meeting then 'unanimously resolved to appoint Shri L.K. Advani as the new President of the Bharatiya Janata Party'; the statement adds that 'His appointment will be duly ratified at the meeting of the Party's National Council, which will be held shortly in New Delhi'.

locator.section: sentences beginning 'Thereafter, the meeting unanimously resolved'
